chapter.heading: The Righteousness of God’s Judgment
chapter.v:
“I was
sought by those who did not ask for Me;I was found by those who did not seek Me.I said, ‘Here I am, here I am,’To a nation that was not called by My name.

Who say,
‘Keep to yourself,Do not come near me,For I am holier than you!’These are smoke in My nostrils,A fire that burns all the day. [Jer. 9:4 h Deut.]

“Behold, it
is written before Me:I will not keep silence, but will repay—Even repay into their bosom— [Matt. 10:36; Mark 3:21; Luke 8:19; John 7:5]

Your iniquities
and the iniquities of your fathers together,”Says the Lord,“Who have burned incense on the mountainsAnd blasphemed Me on the hills;Therefore I will measure their former work into their bosom.” [Ps. 130:5; Is. 25:9; Lam. 3:24,]

Thus says
the Lord:“As the new wine is found in the cluster,And one says, ‘Do not destroy it,For a blessing is in it,’So will I do for My servants’ sake,That I may not destroy them all. [Prov. 24:17; Obad. 12; [Acts 10:43] l Ps. 37:24; [Prov. 24:16]; 2 Cor. 4:9]

I will
bring forth descendants from Jacob,And from Judah an heir of My mountains;My elect shall inherit it,And My servants shall dwell there. [Lam. 3:39, 40; [2 Cor. 5:21] n Jer.]

Sharon shall
be a fold of flocks,And the Valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down,For My people who have sought Me. [Ps. 35:26 p Ps.]

“But you
are those who forsake the Lord,Who forget My holy mountain,Who prepare a table for Gad,And who furnish a drink offering for Meni. [Is. 54:11; [Amos 9:11]]

Therefore I
will number you for the sword,And you shall all bow down to the slaughter;Because, when I called, you did not answer;When I spoke, you did not hear,But did evil before My eyes,And chose that in which I do not delight.” [[Is. 11:16; of Egypt]

Behold, My
servants shall sing for joy of heart,But you shall cry for sorrow of heart,And wail for grief of spirit. [Is. 37:24]

So that
he who blesses himself in the earthShall bless himself in the God of truth;And he who swears in the earthShall swear by the God of truth;Because the former troubles are forgotten,And because they are hidden from My eyes.The Glorious New Creation [Job 21:5] [Is. 26:11]

“For behold,
I create new heavens and a new earth;And the former shall not be remembered or come to mind. [Jer. 33:9] [Ps. 72:9; [Is. 49:23] z Ps. 18:45 sal regathering of Gods people in His land (see Deut. 30:1–6).]

But be
glad and rejoice forever in what I create;For behold, I create Jerusalem as a rejoicing,And her people a joy. [Ex. 15:11 c Ex. 34:6, 7, 9; Is. 43:25; Jer. 50:20 d Mic. 4:7 e Ps. 103:8, 9, 13; [Is. 57:16] f [Ezek. 33:11]]

I will
rejoice in Jerusalem,And joy in My people;The voice of weeping shall no longer be heard in her,Nor the voice of crying.

“No more
shall an infant from there live but a few days,Nor an old man who has not fulfilled his days;For the child shall die one hundred years old,But the sinner being one hundred years old shall be accursed. [Luke 1:72, 73 $] [Ps. 105:9]

They shall
build houses and inhabit them;They shall plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

They shall
not build and another inhabit;They shall not plant and another eat;For as the days of a tree, so shall be the days of My people,And My elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.

They shall
not labor in vain,Nor bring forth children for trouble;For they shall be the descendants of the blessed of the Lord,And their offspring with them.

“It shall
come to passThat before they call, I will answer;And while they are still speaking, I will hear.

The wolf
and the lamb shall feed together,The lion shall eat straw like the ox,And dust shall be the serpent’s food.They shall not hurt nor destroy in all My holy mountain,”Says the Lord.
